description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, targeting Twinflame.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Fork, creating a copy of Twinflame, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist you control triggers, creating that many Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Storm-Kiln Artist and Revolutionist with haste.
When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fork to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
After the first iteration, you may instead target Revolutionist and any other creature you control using the Twinflame copies.
